{{Top|leg}}
'''Rice''' was a grain that grew on many [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. It was used in the creation of several dishes: [[Mounder potato rice]], a food originating from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] which also used [[Potato/Legends|potato]], [[Ghoba rice]] and [[Chandad]] with rice filling. It was also used in the production of beverages like [[Breath of Heaven]] or [[Deuterium-pyro]].
